Core pages (General, Models, Plugins, Agent Presets,"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" Account) stay visible by default. Hiding an entry does not disable its plugin."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"中文说明"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Preview"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The screenshot shows 1.2.0; 1.3.0 groups the live entries by surface."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- Hide or show any settings section from the left navigation.
- Changes apply immediately and persis"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"t in your browser.
- Discovers live `settings.section`, `settings.plugins.tab`, and `plugins.item` c"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ontributions, including new DSH 0.2 plugin configuration entries.
- Removed plugins no longer linger"},{"id":"p9s4","text":": the list only shows currently registered sections.
- Manual refresh (`⟳`) re-syncs the list withou"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"t deleting preferences for temporarily unloaded plugins.
- Core settings pages, including Account, s"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"tay visible by default; new plugin tabs and configuration entries also start visible.
- Disabling or"},{"id":"p9s7","text":" unloading the drawer restores the original registry and releases subscriptions.
- No dependency on "},{"id":"p9s8","text":"generated CSS class names or DOM mutation observers.
- Pure client-side UI plugin — no extra service"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"s, no network calls."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"From GitHub:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Official DSH 0.2 Desktop uses the `desktop` profile. Older EAC d"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"istributions may still use `web-desktop`; select the profile your distribution actually runs. See th"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"e official Desktop command instructions."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"From a locally packed or release tarball:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"For Desktop tarballs, use `--profile desktop` with the bundled command. When upgrading from 1.2.0, a full page reload or app r"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"estart is required to remove that version's unmanaged observer and registry wrapper."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. Open **Settings**.
2. Open **设置抽屉** (Settings Drawer) at the top of the left nav.
3. Uncheck item"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"s in **设置栏目**, **插件标签**, or **插件配置项**. The corresponding entry disappears immediately. Groups with n"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"o registered entries are omitted.
4. **只显示核心项** retains the core sections, the `all` plugin tab, and"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" the built-in Shell, Agent Loop, Subagent, and Web Search configuration entries. **恢复默认** clears sav"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" Shell, Agent Loop, Subagent, and Web Search configuration entries. **恢复默认** clears saved overrides."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Item | Value |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| npm package name | `dsh-settings-drawer` |

| localSto"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"rage key | `dsh_settings_drawer_config_v2` |
| Default visible sections | General, Models, Plugins, "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"Agent Presets, Account, and the legacy `dock` / `dsh-prompt` entries |
| New plugin surfaces | Visib"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"le by default; independent `visiblePluginTabs` and `visiblePluginItems` maps |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1.2.0's `enableDrawer` and `visibleCards` values are retained under the same storage key. Explicit c"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"hoices, including hiding a core page, are preserved.
